and user data under that ``client_name`` prefix, asking for confirmation and listing the scope first. Do not change an instance ID once it is in use; this command offers no rename.

cli.module.help:
Module installation and global loading: list / add / remove / update / load / unload

The three levels of "enabled": add/remove decides whether the code is installed in this instance; load/unload decides whether the module takes part in command matching (equivalent to `~module load` / `~module unload` in the bot, superuser); whether a group or channel may use it is a scene-level switch handled by `~module enable` / `~module disable` in the bot (scene admin). This command group does not use enable/disable for global loading.

The ``--json`` contract: stdout carries exactly one result JSON line (``updated`` / ``failed`` / ``skipped`` /
